text.p: Rakvere Meat Factory's audited 1996 net profit was 4.337 million kroons compared to a loss of 19.3 million kroons the previous year, the company said on Thursday.
Rakvere's unaudited 1996 net profit figures had previously shown a figure of two million kroons.
Rakvere's audited 1996 net turnover was 546.695 million kroons, it added in a statement.
The turnover rose by seven percent compared to 1995.
It invested 17.6 million kroons in 1996 in order to back the planned production capacity increase of ten percent in 1997.
The net profit grew by over two million kroons after the figures were audited because of the collection of additional financial revenues, the company said.
Operating costs fell by 3.9 million kroons or 13 percent in 1996, it said.
Rakvere assets stood at 440 million kroons as of the end of 1996.
The company's shares were in demand Wednesday and Thursday on the bourse ahead of the announcement.
